fieldNotes.location: Confirmed Anheuser-Busch Merrimack Brewery, 221 Daniel Webster Hwy. Roster coords were ~3.2 km off (movedMeters 3205). Locked center on the main brewhouse/warehouse mass at 42.82530,-71.48650. Identity confirmed by the brewing complex layout (brewhouse, tank farm, 400,000+ sq ft processing facility) between the Everett Turnpike and the Merrimack River, with the on-site Budweiser Brewery Experience visitor center and Clydesdale Hamlet.
fieldNotes.operatingStatus: IMPORTANT - AB announced (Dec 2025) the Merrimack brewery will close in early 2026 as part of the same realignment that closed Fairfield CA and Newark NJ; 125 jobs affected. As of the audit date (May 2026) the facility has very likely ceased brewing operations. Audit reflects the physical yard infrastructure from pre-closure imagery.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Large fenced industrial facility - chain-link perimeter fence confirmed in Street View along the W dock face and along Daniel Webster Hwy. Controlled access road into the campus; the truck enters a fenced yard. Exact gate structure not positively confirmed (no clear perimeter Street View of the truck gate).
fieldNotes.guardShack: A guarded entry is standard for an AB brewery of this scale; a small structure sits at an internal truck-circulation node and a booth-sized structure is near the W parking entrance, but the truck-gate guard booth could not be positively confirmed - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access from the property line to the dock yard with ample stacking room.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors with backed-in trailers along the W building face (clearly visible in Street View) plus a secondary dock cluster; ~35 estimated, 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer parking yard on the N side of the building holding ~90 trailers in marked rows; 50+ band, capacity ~160.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on separate building faces (W dock face vs N/interior docks).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs to the brewery from the N - rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: brewhouse with tank farm, packaging warehouses, ancillary buildings, separate visitor center (Brewery Experience) and Clydesdale Hamlet.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site between the Everett Turnpike and the Merrimack River, surrounded by woods and the river corridor - Rural setting.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified - flagged uncertain.
